title: Political Compass or Spinning Arrow? Towards More Meaningful Evaluations for Values and Opinions in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting Large Language Models (LLMs) with propositions from the Political Compass Test (PCT) under various constrained (forced multiple-choice) and unconstrained (open-ended) settings to measure their ideological leanings on economic (left/right) and social (libertarian/authoritarian) scales.
